highlights_headline: Upcoming Skia m158 servicing corrects mask-filtered glyph paths, format checks and clipped image layout.

bullets.lead: Changing glyph loads no longer reuse stale image properties
bullets.detail: Rasterizes the reloaded glyph's path, clears incompatible or sub-byte mask output instead of copying it, and preserves full plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. This avoids format assertions, buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. Package versions and managed APIs are unchanged.
